CanonAdditions: The village of Pinehollow exists and is located on an ordinary road.
The tavern in Pinehollow is named the Crooked Stag.
A contract was signed between the companions and the village elder for a rescue mission.
The reward for the mission is fifty gold pieces plus five gold per head for living captives.
Nella, an adult apprentice of the blacksmith, went missing while carrying tools to a farm near the creek bend.
Hobb, a cart driver, is also missing.
Goblins are raiding farms in the area.
The goblin band operates under Chief Skrit Ironjaw.
The goblins occupy the cellars of an abandoned border keep beyond the woods.
The keep has a broken outer wall, a guard post, a crude alarm, a trapped passage, a storage chamber, and a chief's room.
Nella was carrying tools including leather straps, metal clamps, and a hammer with a splintered wooden handle.
Hobb was likely carrying stolen goods or equipment.
The goblins left behind crude rope fragments and an iron arrowhead.
The companions have access to a small vial of quartz dust collected during earlier travels.
Kaelen possesses a brass gauntlet that can cast smoke screens and shields of light.
Maren's hammer has a wooden haft that is sound but dry where it meets the iron head.
Elias carries a sword, dagger, leather armor, and a bronze plate map recovered in an earlier adventure.
Torin carries his established sword and ordinary travel equipment.
Elara retains her chisel, notes, loose quartz dust, and satchel.
The companions are currently several weeks past their previous adventure and have allowed for ordinary recovery.
The local Blight operation remains closed and no one is secretly maintaining it.
The forest keeper's full nature and its reference to a key remain uncertain background lore.
WorldStateUpdates: It is currently evening or night in Pinehollow.
Rain has softened to a drizzle outside the tavern, then intensified into a deluge as the companions left the village.
The companions have departed the Crooked Stag and are moving toward the ruined keep.
Nella's tools were found at her destination farm, but she is missing.
Goblin tracks and evidence of their presence have been confirmed near the farms.
The companions have gathered supplies including a broken cart axle and rope fragments.
The companions are currently in the woods approaching the ruined keep.

Updates: Elias exists and is an established character.
Elias carries a sword, dagger, leather armor, and a bronze plate map recovered in an earlier adventure.
Elias has learned to accept help and share responsibility.
Elias's old side wound was treated and bandaged at the previous ending.
Elias is currently coordinating the group and maintaining morale.
Kaelen exists and is an established character.
Kaelen is a young mage whose established magic includes smoke and shields of light.
Kaelen possesses a brass gauntlet that is an older relic with an incompletely understood connection to the Blight.
Kaelen can choose to leave his gauntlet unworn.
Kaelen was exhausted by the stronger pull in the previous adventure but has received care and rest.
Kaelen's full history is not required reading for a new reader.
Maren exists and is an established character.
Maren is a direct, pragmatic companion with a heavy hammer and established soldierly competence.
Maren judges tools and plans by whether they work, and speaks more plainly than the others.
Maren's hands were burned in the earlier operation and treated; her hammer's damaged wooden haft was replaced before the ending.
Maren is currently carrying a broken cart axle strapped to her shoulder.
Torin exists and is an established character.
Torin is a soldier, watchful and physically capable, carrying his established sword and ordinary travel equipment.
Torin helps with practical logistics and shares the group's burdens.
Torin can admit fear without losing competence.
Elara exists and is an established character.
Elara is a scholar who studies and tests rather than possessing a convenient answer to every new failure.
Elara retains her chisel, notes, loose quartz dust, and satchel.
The three working quartz fragments remain at the closed shrine in Episode 1; they are not in her pack.
Elara's cut hand received ordinary care.

NarrativeStateUpdates: The companions have accepted a bounded contract to recover the missing people and stop goblin raids.
The companions have investigated an attacked farm and confirmed Nella is missing.
The companions have tracked goblins through the woods and are approaching the ruined keep.
The companions have gathered evidence including footprints, rope fragments, and an iron arrowhead.
UnresolvedInformation: Whether Hobb has been taken or if he is still missing.
The exact location of the goblin camp beyond the woods.
Whether there are multiple goblin camps in the area.
The full extent of the goblin band's resources and capabilities.
ExtractionWarnings: Ambiguity exists regarding whether Hobb has been taken or if he is still missing, as only Nella's disappearance was explicitly confirmed at the farm.
